description: A precedent for a similar procedure but a different denial code — superficially comparable, actually not. Generalist cites it; the Critic rejects it.

request.clinicalNote: Persistent mechanical low back pain for three months without radicular features. Straight-leg raise negative bilaterally. Neurological examination normal. NSAIDs and a six-week completed physiotherapy course with limited benefit. No red-flag features. MRI requested to reassure and guide onward referral.
request.denialLetter: Prior authorisation declined under MN-07: imaging not indicated for non-specific low back pain without neurological deficit or red-flag features.

criteria.text: at least six weeks of completed physiotherapy
radiculopathy or neurological deficit documented on examination

precedents.factPattern: MRI lumbar spine, completed physiotherapy, positive SLR with L5 radiculopathy, denied then overturned on appeal.
